snippet.title: Think Insurance
snippet.description:
I am not only going to teach you what you need to know about insurance, I’m going to show you how to save money with better coverage!  

Hi, my name is Mark Flockhart. I am an insurance expert licensed in multiple states for personal lines insurance. My channel reviews new companies, helps you save money on your current insurance and, teaches you what you need to know about your policy.

Mission 1: To help others be smarter about insurance, ultimately allowing them to make the decisions that is best for their life and family. 

Mission 2: Sales and business advice for aspiring agents to help understand their customer's needs and wants in order to align your products with their life.

snippet.title: Clark Howard: Save More, Spend Less
snippet.description:
Clark Howard has been sharing unbiased advice to help people save more and spend less for more than 30 years. As the host of The Clark Howard Show and founder of Clark.com, Clark and his team share practical and actionable ways you can improve your financial life today. From breaking news to economic trends to pivotal topics, he breaks down everything you need to know to make solid decisions for your wallet and your life. You can expect straightforward tips on managing debt, credit, monthly bills, savings, retirement, and more.

Team Clark is adamant that we will never produce content influenced by or paid for by an advertiser. To support our work, we do make money from some links to companies and deals on our website. Read more about our guarantee here: https://clark.com/ad-disclosure/
